description: This file defines the RetrieveThings class, which represents a command to retrieve multiple Thing objects by their IDs within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing, parsing from JSON, and manipulating such commands, along with associated builder classes.

classes.name: RetrieveThings
classes.description: Final class representing a command to retrieve multiple things by their IDs, including JSON serialization/deserialization, builder pattern, and associated properties.

classes.name: RetrieveThings.Builder
classes.description: Builder class to facilitate creation of RetrieveThings instances, allowing configuration of headers, selected fields, namespace, and final construction.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Static method to create a builder for retrieving things, accepting ThingId varargs or list.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create RetrieveThings from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getThingEntityIds
methods.description: Returns the list of ThingIds to be retrieved.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the optional namespace associated with the command.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns the optional selected JSON fields for the response.
